scope: Audit WP6 golden E2E scenarios E01-E18 mapped to what actually exists; statuses are evidence classes, not completion claims.

statusMeaning.covered-by-unit: real process/unit test with fault injection
statusMeaning.covered-by-contract: contract test with fakes for the external side
statusMeaning.partial: some conditions covered, listed gap remains
statusMeaning.covered-by-e2e-stub: real client/SDK code path against a local stand-in for the external service
